Ayoze Perez.why: Ayoze Perez gets on the end of everything, as if the ball is on a string! He picks his spots like a jeweller choosing diamonds. He never stops shooting, bless his thunderous boots.

Fabian Ruiz.why: Fabian Ruiz is a law unto himself, and the law is pure entertainment! He plays with pure joy, a kid in the park in a grown man's kit.

Joao Pedro Goncalves Neves.why: Joao Pedro Goncalves Neves haunts that penalty box like a ghost with a grudge and a key to the front door! He never stops shooting, bless his thunderous boots. He is the main event, and everyone else is the warm-up.

Tanitoluwa Oluwatimikhin Oluwaseyi.why: Tanitoluwa Oluwatimikhin Oluwaseyi is a mystery wrapped in an enigma wrapped in a gorgeous pair of boots! He brings the fireworks, the confetti and the brass band.

Renato De Palma Veiga.why: Renato De Palma Veiga is a showman down to his bootlaces, a headline act!

Warren Zaire Emery.why: Warren Zaire Emery waits for the moment like a heron over a still pond! He could light up a wet Tuesday in a car park.

Pape Alassane Gueye.why: Pape Alassane Gueye is lightning in a bottle, every minute a jolt! He has a cannon for a right foot and loves to fire it. And he has magic in his boots and mischief in his eyes.

Maghnes Akliouche.why: Maghnes Akliouche is a fox in the henhouse with his napkin already tucked in! He never wastes a bullet, every shot a love letter to the net. He will have a dig from the car park, the corner flag, the tunnel.

Sergi Cardona.why: Sergi Cardona packs his minutes with mischief and menace! He is a poet with a football and a smile like a sunrise.

Alassane Diatta.why: Alassane Diatta is lightning in a bottle, every minute a jolt! He is a burglar in the penalty box, in and out before the alarm goes. And he is pure theatre in a pair of boots, a matinee idol.
